semanticRevisions.after: For a controller running multiple replicas with leader election, an unmarked Pod lost during an upgrade, a leader switch, or deletion or node failure of the leader is handled by the successor as an actual Pod deletion seen in continuous operation and recovered at the recoveryPolicy scope without grace. Losses during a complete controller failure or after controller deletion may be refilled or recovered at that scope; controller absence in a single-replica deployment and a controller manually scaled to zero are handled as a complete failure. Situations the user did not mention conform with either outcome. Recovery never exceeds the policy scope. The single upgrade to the first implementing version may refill only. Counts, ordinals and versions follow the latest spec, applicable history and partition. New-process grace restart, marked deletion continuation, Terminating occupancy, budgets, UID/owner fencing and refill-only None are retained. No member table is added and cause detection is not prescribed.
